answer: In an agent economy, each participant must lock a non-fungible jade credential obtained through verified real-world proof-of-work or capital commitment. Periodically, agents broadcast a cryptographic beacon tied to their jade, which peers confirm only through encrypted whisper channels that require prior mutual authentication. This forces Sybil attackers to either purchase scarce jade at market prices or fabricate continuous authenticated whispers, both of which incur substantial ongoing costs that scale with the number of fake identities.
